sourceProjectRole: Previously authorized 258 GUID model; immutable source
targetProjectRole: One separately authorized copy retaining source GUIDs
baseline: Fresh identity, saved SHA, journal and full native retention signatures before write
placementGate: Actual retained native bounds must not intersect target areas; home story must exist
materialSource: Existing native tool defaults; independently read actual resulting bindings
executor: Existing DynamicCommands.execute -> SceneWriter -> existing SQLite intent-before-write journal
persistence: Existing journaled SaveProject/OpenProject with all original GUID/signature checks
repeatPolicy: Reuse completed journal result plus fresh readback, never blind Create repeat
opening: Read existing previously recorded Opening from another authorized isolated model; no Opening creation required
